design.illustrations: Original SVG conceptual diagrams, not business photographs
design.logo: Original P typographic mark; owner approval pending

features: Dated Google rating when at least 10 reviews
Estimate requests for work at customer properties
Owner contact, service confirmation, area, hours and privacy editor

actions.requests: Off until four launch gates AND two approved privacy texts; stored in owner inbox
actions.appointments: No time slots or automatic confirmation

contentRules: No invented licensing, staff, years, testimonials, prices, warranties or arrival promises
Unverified services are proposals to confirm
Hours, areas, free estimates and payments require public source verification
gaps: Owner has not reviewed or approved this proposal
Independent website and buying entity still need owner confirmation
Exact service scope and site constraints confirmed directly

sources.notes: Profile individually opened; phone, rating, reviews, address and linked website transcribed.
Business-linked listing checked. Phone matches Google Maps. Listed service scope, 24/7 hours, service area, email, payments and free estimates transcribed.
